limitations: Proof relies on exact owned Popen/relay and fully visible isolated DB sessions; application_name is not an authenticated production identity
Native proof authenticates its own issued objects for the local test; no operational proof issuer, actual Pod UID, workload federation or new product verifier deployed
Remote sleep and retained relay socket are deliberate fixtures; only the real native PG copy and commit/rollback/data readback are under test
Uncommitted copy yields UNKNOWN and RecoveryRequired on current product; source stays fenced and migration is incomplete, explicit operator-hold UI remains a separate integration
No fixed product image/worker Pod or independent cloud/onprem path; inventory/IdP/trust bootstrap, file route and local witness remain fixtures
Native plan budgets 60s/120s remain; this is not continuous-load or 5s client qualification
SIGKILL is controlled after a real observed boundary; no production end-to-end deadline/watchdog is added
